title: Settled-receipt pruning can evict a Rejected receipt that still holds the prompt's only retry copy
outcome: Settled-receipt pruning can evict a Rejected receipt that still holds the prompt's only retry copy
acceptance: prune_prompt_deliveries (src/prompt_delivery.rs) evicts settled receipts without a retry entry (Accepted, Ambiguous) before a Rejected receipt that still carries its entry, or exempts such Rejected receipts, and the rule is documented with the cap.
A test settles more than the cap of receipts after one rejection and shows the rejected prompt still re-queueable.
